label: Explainer

kinds.title: Opening card that names what the video explains.
kinds.step: One step of the process with an icon; steps are numbered in order.
kinds.diagram: A flow of boxes and arrows that draw in order, for how parts connect.
kinds.cta: Closing card: the one action viewers should take, with a button.
kinds.video: Real footage in a window, e.g. a screen recording or research film: it plays under the voice, or with its own sound.
kinds.flash: Kinetic type: 2-12 words flash full frame one at a time on the beat of the voice, then an optional title lands and holds, e.g. nine workstreams ending on "One partnership."
kinds.model: A 3D model of the product (a .glb file) in studio light with a soft shadow, turning slowly on the scene background under a title: for a physical product or device the viewer should see from every side.
kinds.anim: A Lottie animation (a .json export from After Effects or LottieFiles, uploaded in the Brand tab) playing in a window under a title: for motion a designer authored, e.g. a product icon animation or an animated diagram.
kinds.type3d: A short word or number as solid 3D letters in the brand display font, rising into place one by one under studio light, e.g. "2x faster" or "Ready.": a headline moment.
kinds.device: An app or web screen on a 3D phone, tablet or laptop (the lid opens), turning slowly in studio light; a tall screenshot scrolls from top to bottom while the voice runs.
kinds.swarm: Thousands of points fly in from all round and settle into a word, an icon or the brand logo: an opening or a reveal.
kinds.cards: 2-6 photos as instant prints in 3D: a row the camera glides along, a fan that opens print by print, or a ring that turns each print to the front in turn.
kinds.globe: A turning globe in the brand colours: 1-8 places pop up with a label, then arcs join them, e.g. offices, markets or a delivery route.

fields.step.icon: An icon for this step. One icon morphs from step to step.
fields.video.tags: JSON list of exactly 2 short labels (16 characters each) for a split-screen clip, one over each half, e.g. ["Old", "New"].
fields.flash.items: JSON list of 2-12 words or short phrases, each at most 40 characters (a long one wraps to two lines), e.g. ["Strategy", "Design", "Build"]. Say them in this order in the voice line. An item that starts with a word of the voice line flashes as that word is spoken.
fields.flash.title: Lands after the last item and holds to the end of the scene, e.g. "One partnership." Say it last.
fields.flash.video: Optional footage behind the words, full frame, blurred and dimmed (e.g. a screen recording of the flow the items describe). Muted; it plays from the scene start and holds its last frame.
fields.video: The video clip (.mp4, .webm or .mov) from the project assets.
fields.in: Where the clip starts in the file, in seconds.
fields.out: Where it ends, in seconds (at most 120 s of clip).
fields.sound: Plays the clip's own sound; the scene then lasts as long as the clip, so keep the voice line empty or short.
fields.title.theme: dark: a centred title on the brand dark colour, for a cold open; accent: the same on the brand secondary colour.
fields.theme: light (default), dark (the brand dark colour) or accent (the brand secondary colour). Mix them so the film is not all white.
fields.caption: With sound on and no voice line: what the clip says, word for word, for the captions (timed on the heard speech). Without it the captions come from speech recognition.
fields.model: The 3D model (.glb, glTF 2.0 binary) from the project assets.
fields.model.spin: turn (default): the model turns on its axis; orbit: the camera circles it; hero: it sways while the camera eases in; reveal: it rises and grows into place in the first second, then turns slowly; detail: the camera pushes in to a close-up, e.g. for a finish or a texture.
fields.model.view: Optional start pose as JSON, each key optional: {"azimuth": 30, "elevation": 12, "zoom": 1}. azimuth -180 to 180 degrees round the model, elevation -30 to 60 degrees above it, zoom 0.6 (farther) to 1.6 (closer). Empty keeps the spin's own pose (about 29 degrees round, 13 up, zoom 1).
fields.model.shadow: true (default): a soft contact shadow under the model; false drops it, e.g. for a model that floats.
fields.model.env: studio (default): studio light reflects in the model, so metal and glass read; brand: the same room in the brand colours, so the reflections carry the brand; none: plain lamps only.
fields.model.bloom: Optional glow from the model's bright highlights, 0 to 1 (e.g. 0.4): for glossy or lit products, a hero moment. Leave it out for a plain, sharp look.
fields.model.focus: true: the model's centre stays sharp and its nearer and farther edges soften, like a close-up lens; reads best with the detail spin or a close zoom. false (default): all sharp.
fields.hold: Seconds (0-4) of quiet after the scene's sound ends: with sound on, the scene keeps the clip's last frame that long, so a short bite does not cut away at once. The Timeline in Preview sets it on any scene.
fields.model.path: Optional camera path as JSON: 2-4 poses shaped like view, e.g. [{"azimuth": -40, "zoom": 1}, {"azimuth": 30, "elevation": 20, "zoom": 1.4}]. The camera glides from pose to pose across the scene, settling at each; a missing key keeps the start pose's value. Replaces the spin's own camera move; the spin still turns the model.
fields.model.explode: Optional exploded view as JSON: 1-6 part names of the model, e.g. ["front", "core"] (the node names in the .glb; a pack from pack-glb has front, back and rim). The parts move out from the centre a third of the way into the scene and stay out.
fields.model.gap: How far exploded parts move: 0.1 to 1 of the model's size (default 0.45).
fields.model.decal: Optional sticker as JSON: a brand or built-in icon stamped on the model's front face, e.g. {"icon": "shield", "at": [0.85, 0.15], "size": 0.28, "part": "front"}. at is [x, y] as fractions of the face (0,0 top-left), size its height as a fraction of the face (0.1-0.6), part the node it rides on (so it explodes with it). Drawn in the brand secondary on a white plate.
fields.lottie: The Lottie animation (.json) from the project assets.
fields.anim.loop: true (default): a short animation repeats until the scene ends; false: it plays once and holds its last frame.
fields.anim.fit: contain (default): the whole animation fits the window; cover: it fills the window, edges cropped.
fields.cta.image: Optional background photo from the project assets (e.g. the pack or a lifestyle shot), faded under the brand colour on the text side so the button still reads.
fields.word: The 3D word or number, at most 16 characters, e.g. "98%" or "Launch day". Say it in the voice line.
fields.screen: The screenshot (.png, .jpg or .webp) from the project assets shown on the device screen. A portrait screenshot suits a phone; a tall one (a whole page) scrolls.
fields.device: phone (default), tablet (turns landscape for a wide screenshot) or laptop (its lid opens at the start).
fields.form: What the points settle into: word (the word field, or the brand name), icon (the icon field) or logo (the brand logo; the brand name without one).
fields.swarm.icon: An icon name from the context's icons list, for form icon.
fields.swarm.word: The word for form word, at most 16 characters.
fields.photos: JSON list of 2-6 photos from the project assets, each with an optional caption of at most 32 characters: [{"asset": "team.jpg", "caption": "Kick-off day"}].
fields.arrange: row (default): the camera glides along the prints, resting on each in turn as the voice goes; fan: the prints rise one by one into a fanned hand; ring: the prints stand round a ring that turns each to the front.
fields.points: JSON list of 1-8 places: [{"lat": 59.33, "lon": 18.07, "label": "Stockholm"}], latitude -90 to 90, longitude -180 to 180, label at most 20 characters. They pop up in this order through the voice line.
fields.arcs: hub (default): arcs from the first place to each other one; chain: from each place to the next; none: no arcs.
fields.model.clip: Optional: the name of one animation in the .glb to play (e.g. "Open"); without it every animation in the file plays.
fields.model.paints: Optional colour changes as JSON, 1-4: [{"color": "secondary", "part": "cap", "cue": "yellow"}]. color is a hex colour (#e11d48) or a brand colour (primary, primary2, secondary, ink, bg); part a node of the .glb (whole model without it); cue a word of the voice line where the change starts (spread evenly without it). Reads best on plain parts; a printed texture is tinted.
fields.model.swap: Optional second model as JSON: {"model": "pack-new.glb", "cue": "new"}: at the cue word (half way without it) the first model spins out and the second spins in, e.g. old pack to new pack. The camera, spin and light carry on; explode, decal, paints and material stay on the first.
fields.model.material: Optional stock look as JSON: {"look": "glass", "parts": ["cap"]} (look glass, chrome, gold or clay; parts optional, the whole model without them), or just "chrome". Glass is clear in the middle with bright edges; chrome and gold read best with studio or brand light.
fields.type3d.spin: hero (default): the word sways gently; turn and orbit show its sides; reveal rises it in; detail pushes in.
fields.device.spin: hero (default): the device sways gently, its screen toward the viewer; reveal rises it in; detail pushes in on the screen; turn and orbit also show its back.
fields.type3d.view: Optional start pose as JSON, each key optional: {"azimuth": 30, "elevation": 12, "zoom": 1}. azimuth -180 to 180 degrees round it, elevation -30 to 60 degrees above it, zoom 0.6 (farther) to 1.6 (closer). Empty keeps the spin's own pose.
fields.type3d.path: Optional camera path as JSON: 2-4 poses shaped like view, e.g. [{"azimuth": -20, "zoom": 1}, {"azimuth": 20, "zoom": 1.3}]. The camera glides from pose to pose across the scene; replaces the spin's own camera move.
fields.type3d.env: studio (default): studio light reflects in it; brand: the same room in the brand colours; none: plain lamps only.
fields.type3d.bloom: Optional glow from the letters' bright highlights, 0 to 1 (e.g. 0.4), for a hero moment. Leave it out for a plain, sharp look.
fields.type3d.focus: true: the word's centre stays sharp and its nearer and farther letters soften. false (default): all sharp.
fields.type3d.shadow: true (default): a soft contact shadow under the word; false drops it.
fields.device.view: Optional start pose as JSON, each key optional: {"azimuth": 30, "elevation": 12, "zoom": 1}. azimuth -180 to 180 degrees round it, elevation -30 to 60 degrees above it, zoom 0.6 (farther) to 1.6 (closer). Empty keeps the spin's own pose.
fields.device.path: Optional camera path as JSON: 2-4 poses shaped like view, e.g. [{"azimuth": -20, "zoom": 1}, {"azimuth": 20, "zoom": 1.3}]. The camera glides from pose to pose across the scene; replaces the spin's own camera move.
fields.device.env: studio (default): studio light reflects in it; brand: the same room in the brand colours; none: plain lamps only.
fields.device.bloom: Optional glow from the device's bright highlights, 0 to 1 (e.g. 0.4), for a hero moment. Leave it out for a plain, sharp look.
fields.device.focus: true: the screen stays sharp and the device's nearer and farther edges soften. false (default): all sharp.
fields.device.shadow: true (default): a soft contact shadow under the device; false drops it.
fields.swarm.spin: hero (default): the settled shape sways gently; turn and orbit show it from the sides; reveal rises it in; detail pushes in.
fields.swarm.view: Optional start pose as JSON, each key optional: {"azimuth": 30, "elevation": 12, "zoom": 1}. azimuth -180 to 180 degrees round it, elevation -30 to 60 degrees above it, zoom 0.6 (farther) to 1.6 (closer). Empty keeps the spin's own pose.
fields.swarm.path: Optional camera path as JSON: 2-4 poses shaped like view, e.g. [{"azimuth": -20, "zoom": 1}, {"azimuth": 20, "zoom": 1.3}]. The camera glides from pose to pose across the scene; replaces the spin's own camera move.
fields.swarm.bloom: Optional glow from the points as they settle, 0 to 1 (e.g. 0.4), for a hero moment. Leave it out for a plain, sharp look.
fields.cards.env: studio (default): studio light reflects in it; brand: the same room in the brand colours; none: plain lamps only.
fields.cards.bloom: Optional glow from the prints' bright highlights, 0 to 1 (e.g. 0.4), for a hero moment. Leave it out for a plain, sharp look.
fields.globe.bloom: Optional glow from the pins, arcs and the globe's rim, 0 to 1 (e.g. 0.4), for a hero moment. Leave it out for a plain, sharp look.

description: Explains how something works: a title, numbered steps where one icon morphs from step to step with a progress bar, flow diagrams whose boxes and arrows draw in order, real footage in a window, a 3D model of the product turning on the scene background, full-frame kinetic type that flashes words on the beat, then the call to action. Body scenes can switch to a dark or accent background.

anim.title: See it move
anim.text: One sentence about what the animation shows.
